content.question: What is the hallmark of a feedforward neural network?
options: Information flows in one direction through the layers, without cycles or feedback loops.
Information can loop back from later layers to earlier ones to keep context.
The network processes data one time step at a time using internal memory.
The network uses attention heads to relate every input to every other input.
content.answer: Information flows in one direction through the layers, without cycles or feedback loops.
